First, note the year 1012 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century year in this case).  
August 30, 1012 + 218 days:  
From Aug 30 to Dec 31:  
Aug: 1 day left (31-30) → actually 31-30=1 day? Wait: Aug 30 → Aug 31 is 1 day, so days in Aug after 30th = 1 (Aug 31).  
Better: Days remaining in 1012 after Aug 30:  
Aug: 31-30 = 1 day (Aug 31)  
Sep: 30 days  
Oct: 31  
Nov: 30  
Dec: 31  
Total = 1+30+31+30+31 = 123 days.  

218 total days to add: first 123 days take us to Dec 31, 1012.  
Remaining days = 218 - 123 = 95 days into 1013.  

1013 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31 → 31+28+31 = 90 days (Jan 1 to Mar 31 total days = 90).  
95 days from Jan 1: after 90 days → end of Mar 31, 5 days left → Apr 5, 1013.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1013-04-05
